# YoPrompts

> Ready-made AI prompts by F9XR Team. Copy a prompt, paste it into ChatGPT,
> Claude, Gemini, or any tool that follows them, and get a better result than
> writing the request from scratch. Public, free to use, no login.

YoPrompts is a library of tested, ready-to-copy prompts. Each prompt page
documents the full prompt text, the category it belongs to, the AI models it
was checked against, a difficulty level, how to use it, tips for better
results, an example of the output shape, and an FAQ.

## Core

- [All prompts](https://f9xr.org/yoprompts/prompts/): searchable and filterable index of the whole library.
- [AI agent skills](https://f9xr.org/yoprompts/ai-agent-skills/): installable skills that extend what an AI agent can do.
- [MCP servers](https://f9xr.org/yoprompts/mcp-server-index/): Model Context Protocol servers that connect agents to tools and data.
- [Categories](https://f9xr.org/yoprompts/categories/): browse by the job a prompt does.
- [Prompting basics](https://f9xr.org/yoprompts/resources/#prompting-basics): the five techniques that fix most bad output.
